memo: Incumbent is now mean_adjusted 1.0521 over 2 runs. Slot 14 halved TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 2**17 and gave 1.0518/1.0525 (-0.0624), the only accept. It carries a tripwire flag, so check it before building on it. Smaller batch means more optimizer steps in the fixed 300 s, so batch is the winning family. Earlier single-run tweaks were small: weight decay 0.1 (-0.0025), batch 2**18 (-0.0025), MATRIX_LR 0.03 (-0.0027), warmup 0.03 (-0.0022), WARMDOWN_RATIO 0.7 (-0.0020).
